ai.name: DeepSeek
ai.hook: V4.1-Flash: 763B causal encoder-decoder, MIT license, extreme efficiency, beats prior flagship.

ai.why_it_made_the_cut: Highest-profile capability claim this week; signals new frontier for model scaling beyond training.
